republique.blurb: Come in the morning for Margarita Manzke's pastries; she won a James Beard Award for them in 2023. At night the back room turns into a French dinner.

spago.pullQuote: Wolfgang Puck's flagship, home of the smoked salmon pizza.
spago.blurb: Ask for the smoked salmon pizza with dill crème fraîche and caviar, a Puck original. The menu is Californian, with a tasting menu.

cantinetta-bellevue.pullQuote: Handmade tagliatelle carbonara on Bellevue's Main Street.
cantinetta-bellevue.blurb: Order the tagliatelle carbonara or the pappardelle Bolognese, the two signature pastas. The fall menu adds pici cacio e pepe.

jon-vinnys.pullQuote: Spicy fusilli and an L.A. Woman pizza on Fairfax.
jon-vinnys.blurb: Get the spicy fusilli in vodka sauce with basil and parmesan, plus the L.A. Woman pizza topped with cold local burrata.

heavy-handed.pullQuote: Short-rib cheeseburgers and beef-tallow fries on Main Street.
heavy-handed.blurb: Order a double: ground short rib, American cheese, caramelized onions, house pickles and heavy sauce. The fries are cooked in beef tallow.

venice-flake.pullQuote: Breakfast burritos and croissant sandwiches on Rose Ave.
venice-flake.blurb: Get the bacon burrito with eggs, American cheese and the house tomatillo salsa, or the Super-Crojo on a croissant. It closes at 3.

elephante.pullQuote: Coastal Italian pizzas and pasta on a Santa Monica rooftop.
elephante.blurb: Start with the soppressata pizza, with chili oil and honey, and a handmade pasta like the vodka canestri. It's a rooftop two blocks from the beach.

levain-bakery.pullQuote: Six-ounce chocolate chip walnut cookies on Abbot Kinney.
levain-bakery.blurb: Order the chocolate chip walnut, the six-ounce cookie that made the New York bakery famous. This Abbot Kinney shop opened in April 2025.

spark-pizza.pullQuote: Pepperoni cups and spicy honey on a 48-hour dough.
spark-pizza.blurb: Order Honey & Spice & Everything Nice: pepperoni cups, Ferndale mozzarella, basil and spicy honey. The crust sits between Neapolitan and New York.

the-ivy.pullQuote: Crab cakes on the flower-filled Robertson patio since 1980.
the-ivy.blurb: Order the crab cakes and Ricky's fried chicken, with whipped potatoes, grilled corn and mango chutney. The patio has been the draw since 1980.

easy-street-burgers.pullQuote: Smashed cheeseburgers with wild sauce in Studio City.
easy-street-burgers.blurb: Order a double cheeseburger: smashed patties, pickles, grilled onions and wild sauce. The Jalapeño Monster swaps in Swiss and jalapeños.

sabys-cafe.pullQuote: Breakfast burritos and blue corn tacos in Mar Vista.
sabys-cafe.blurb: Get the chipotle breakfast burrito with eggs, potatoes, avocado and grilled onions. At lunch, the blue corn quesadilla comes with quesillo.

stk-bellevue.pullQuote: Wagyu Lil' Brgs and steak to a DJ set in Lincoln Square.
stk-bellevue.blurb: Start with the Lil' Brgs, wagyu sliders with special sauce on sesame buns, then a steak. A DJ plays through dinner.

daves-hot-chicken.pullQuote: Nashville hot tenders from the original East Hollywood stand.
daves-hot-chicken.blurb: Get the sliders on potato buns with kale slaw and pickles, at any of seven heat levels from Not Hot to Reaper. It began in a parking lot here in 2017.

woodblock.pullQuote: Brisket gnocchi and a thousand-bottle whiskey wall in Redmond.
woodblock.blurb: Order the brisket gnocchi, made with slow-roasted brisket and gnocchi rolled by hand almost every day. The bar holds about a thousand bottles.

malibu-farm-restaurant.pullQuote: Swedish mini pancakes at the foot of the Malibu Pier.
malibu-farm-restaurant.blurb: Come for brunch and order the Swedish mini pancakes with berry compote and whipped cream. The vegan chop salad is the lunch standby.

shawns-cafe-and-bakery.pullQuote: Scratch-made bagels and Friday challah on Mercer Island.
shawns-cafe-and-bakery.blurb: Come for fresh bagels, croissants and pretzel rolls baked from scratch daily. Pre-order the challah, which is ready Fridays after 11.

ooba-tooba.pullQuote: Grilled chicken burritos with minted rice in Redmond.
ooba-tooba.blurb: Order the grilled chicken burrito with minted rice, white beans and chipotle crema. The chipotle pork tacos are the menu's customer favorite.

a-ma-chicken-rice.pullQuote: Hainanese chicken rice and Phnom Penh noodle soup in Redmond.
a-ma-chicken-rice.blurb: Order the Hainanese chicken rice, cooked in the stock from the poached bird, with ginger-garlic sauce. The kuy teav Phnom Penh is the soup to add.

rovino.pullQuote: Rotisserie half chicken and handmade pasta in Little Italy.
rovino.blurb: Order the half rotisserie chicken with roasted vegetables and potatoes, then a housemade pasta. It takes walk-ins at the bar.

john-howie-steak.pullQuote: 28-day aged Prime filet, grilled over mesquite at The Bravern.
john-howie-steak.blurb: Order the USDA Prime filet, custom-aged 28 days and grilled over mesquite, then splurge on A5 Wagyu by the ounce. Finish with the coconut cream pie.

barons-sino-kitchen-and-bar.pullQuote: Shanghainese smoked mackerel, served under a glass cloche in Bellevue.
barons-sino-kitchen-and-bar.blurb: Order the Shanghainese smoked mackerel, brought to the table under a glass cloche, and the wok-fried seafood noodles. The dining room is on Lincoln Square's second floor.

deru-market.pullQuote: Fig-and-pistachio meatloaf and giant cake slices in Kirkland.
deru-market.blurb: Order the fig and pistachio meatloaf or a wood-fired pizza, then a huge slice of dark chocolate or coconut cake from the deli case.

sparrow.pullQuote: Lamb quesa-birria tacos on a big Juanita patio.
sparrow.blurb: Order the lamb quesa-birria tacos and the Northwest mussels with sausage. The 4,500-square-foot patio is dog-friendly and open all year.

farzi-cafe.pullQuote: Modern Indian plates, from dal makhani to salmon tikka.
farzi-cafe.blurb: Order the double-butter dal makhani, simmered 18 hours, and the salmon tikka with XO jhalmuri. It was Farzi's first U.S. location when it opened in 2023.

seastar-restaurant-and-raw-bar.pullQuote: John Howie's cedar plank salmon and a full raw bar.
seastar-restaurant-and-raw-bar.blurb: Order the cedar plank salmon with smoked broccoli and citrus rice, or the Super Dave Roll from the raw bar. John Howie opened it in 2002.

hokkaido-ramen-santouka.pullQuote: Shio ramen with pork cheek on the side.
hokkaido-ramen-santouka.blurb: Order the tonkotsu shio, the house's signature, with the toroniku: pork cheek served on a separate plate to dip in the broth. No reservations.

el-encanto.pullQuote: Durango family recipes and margaritas on Lake Washington.
el-encanto.blurb: Chef Gabriel Chavez cooks the food of his native Durango here. Try the chile en nogada or the Dungeness crab dobladas, and sit outside facing the lake.

dough-zone-bellevue.pullQuote: Xiao long bao and Q-Bao from the chain that began in Bellevue.
dough-zone-bellevue.blurb: Order the xiao long bao and the Q-Bao, pan-fried soup buns with crisp bottoms. Dough Zone started in Bellevue in 2014.

pacific-inn-pub.pullQuote: Panko-crusted cod and Cajun fried shrimp at a Fremont dive since 1981.
pacific-inn-pub.blurb: Order the fish and chips: thin Pacific cod in a peppery, garlicky panko crust. Add the Cajun fried shrimp and eat on the deck; the pub is 21 and over.

hot-mamas-pizza.pullQuote: New York-style pesto slices on Pine Street since 1995, open late.
hot-mamas-pizza.blurb: Get a slice of the pesto pie, the house's famous one, or the House Combo if you want meat. It's been on Capitol Hill since 1995 and stays open until midnight on weekends.

slice-box-pizza.pullQuote: Sicilian pepperoni squares and cupped-pepperoni New York slices for a SoDo lunch.
slice-box-pizza.blurb: Get the Sicilian pepperoni square, then a New York cheese slice with a crisp, foldable crust. It's a weekday lunch counter, not a dinner spot.

the-box.pullQuote: Da Hilo Boy burger and loco moco from a Kirkland food-truck chef.
the-box.blurb: Order Da Hilo Boy, with a fried egg, bacon confit, mushroom duxelles and peppercorn gravy, or the loco moco. Chef Reis Llaneza started with a food truck.

jacks-bbq.pullQuote: Central Texas brisket and beef ribs on Bel-Red, open since 2024.
jacks-bbq.blurb: Order the Double R Ranch brisket, smoked low and slow, and the dino beef rib if it's Thursday or Sunday. Breakfast tacos start at 7 on weekdays.

desi-tadka.pullQuote: Vegetarian Punjabi thalis and chole bhature on 105th Avenue in Bellevue.
desi-tadka.blurb: Order the chole bhature, chickpeas with two puffed fried breads, or a matar paneer thali. The whole menu is vegetarian, with no-onion, no-garlic options.

ezells-famous-chicken.pullQuote: Spicy fried chicken thighs and sweet dinner rolls, Oprah's Seattle order.
ezells-famous-chicken.blurb: Get it spicy, with dark meat, the way Oprah orders it, plus the sweet fresh-baked rolls. Ezell's has been frying chicken in Seattle since 1984.

burgermaster.pullQuote: Carhop drive-in burgers made with grass-fed beef, a family business since 1952.
burgermaster.blurb: Turn on your headlights and a carhop takes your order at the car. The beef is grass-fed, and the tartar sauce is still Phil Jensen's 1952 recipe.

xochi.pullQuote: Mexico City braised tacos de guisado from a trailer on Gilman Boulevard.
xochi.blurb: Order the chicken tinga and the rajas, poblanos in sour cream. Sandra Diaz stews every filling, and half the board is vegetarian.

cactus-kirkland.pullQuote: Achiote pork tacos and Santa Fe-style stacked enchiladas near Kirkland's Park Lane.
cactus-kirkland.blurb: Order the achiote pork tacos, with a dash of pineapple, or the stacked seafood enchiladas in sherry cream. The flan has been dessert here for decades.

fob-poke-bar-bellevue.pullQuote: Fresh-cut salmon poke bowls with wasabi aioli in downtown Bellevue.
fob-poke-bar-bellevue.blurb: Pick fresh-cut salmon or tuna, add the homemade wasabi aioli and edamame, and choose rice or greens as the base. It's quick for a downtown lunch.

520-bar-and-grill.pullQuote: The 520 Burger and big hot wings at an Old Bellevue bar and grill.
520-bar-and-grill.blurb: Order the 520 Burger, flame-grilled with Swiss or Tillamook cheddar on brioche. Add the hot wings in the house's secret sauce.

broiler-bay.pullQuote: Charbroiled bacon cheeseburgers and crackly onion rings on Main Street since 1989.
broiler-bay.blurb: Get the bacon cheeseburger on its huge sesame bun, with fry sauce and onion rings. Add a milkshake; the room hasn't changed much since 1989.

castilla.pullQuote: Paella mixta and patatas bravas at a Bellevue Square Spanish tapas bar.
castilla.blurb: Order the paella mixta early, since it takes about 30 minutes, then patatas bravas and chorizo empanadas. There are more than 40 tapas.

central-bar-restaurant.pullQuote: Tempura portobello fries and halibut tacos on a BAM Alley patio in Bellevue.
central-bar-restaurant.blurb: Start with the portobello fries, the house's signature appetizer, then the seared halibut tacos. Happy hour runs daily from 2 to 5.

civility-and-unrest.pullQuote: Bartender's-choice cocktails in a dim speakeasy tucked into the W Bellevue.
civility-and-unrest.blurb: Name a spirit and let the bartender build you a drink; this bar is known for off-menu cocktails. The back room, Unrest, opens Thursday to Saturday.

como.pullQuote: Handmade pasta like wild boar pappardelle, with Lake Washington views at Carillon Point.
como.blurb: Order a handmade pasta, like the wild boar pappardelle, and ask for a window or patio table over the lake. The cooking is from Lombardy.

earls-kitchen-bar.pullQuote: Cajun blackened chicken and sticky Korean ribs in a big Lincoln Square room.
earls-kitchen-bar.blurb: Order the Cajun blackened chicken, the chain's long-running signature, and share the sticky Korean ribs. It's a big room that fits a mixed group.

fern-thai-on-main.pullQuote: Crispy garlic chicken and pad Thai at a family-style Thai spot on Main.
fern-thai-on-main.blurb: Order the crispy garlic chicken and a plate of pad Thai to share. The room on Old Bellevue's Main Street suits an easy weeknight dinner.

fogo-de-chao.pullQuote: Tableside-carved picanha and endless churrasco at a Brazilian steakhouse on Bellevue Way.
fogo-de-chao.blurb: Come hungry for the picanha, the prime top sirloin carved at the table. The Market Table of salads, cheeses and cured meats comes with it.

japonessa.pullQuote: The Bellevue Roll and jalapeño-lime sushi at Lincoln Square's loud Latin-accented sushi bar.
japonessa.blurb: Start with the Bellevue Roll, eel and shrimp under tobiko, then the Wicked Sensation with its jalapeño-lime glaze. Happy hour runs twice daily.

joey-bellevue.pullQuote: The JOEY classic steak with crispy mashed potatoes at Bellevue Place.
joey-bellevue.blurb: Order the classic steak, a prime sirloin with loaded crispy mashed potatoes, or the steak and sushi. It's a polished room with a patio.

kobuta-and-ookami-redmond.pullQuote: Mozzarella-stuffed tomato and cheese katsu at the Redmond branch of the Capitol Hill shop.
kobuta-and-ookami-redmond.blurb: Get the tomato and cheese katsu: thin pork wrapped around mozzarella, under a tomato miso sauce. Every set comes with rice, miso soup and cabbage.

kura-revolving-sushi.pullQuote: Conveyor-belt sushi and a prize capsule for every 15 plates near Wilburton.
kura-revolving-sushi.blurb: Grab plates off the belt or order on the touchscreen; every 15 plates earns a Bikkura Pon prize. It's a fun pick with kids.

matador-redmond.pullQuote: Enchiladas divorciadas and a deep tequila list in Redmond's old City Hall building.
matador-redmond.blurb: Order the enchiladas divorciadas, half salsa verde and half salsa roja, with a tequila flight. The brick building was Redmond's City Hall from 1915 to 1927.

naan-n-curry.pullQuote: Lamb dum biryani with saffron rice and fried onions in quilted Issaquah booths.
naan-n-curry.blurb: Order the lamb dum biryani, then malai boti or balti chicken from the Pakistani side of the menu. The biryani is even better as leftovers.

noburu-ramen-and-sushi.pullQuote: Black garlic Noburu Black ramen with chashu and egg, plus sushi, in Redmond.
noburu-ramen-and-sushi.blurb: Order the Noburu Black, a tonkotsu-style bowl with black garlic oil, chashu and a seasoned egg. Rolls fill the other half of the menu.

pagliacci-pizza.pullQuote: A Brooklyn Bridge pie from Seattle's hometown pizza chain, on Bellevue's Main Street.
pagliacci-pizza.blurb: Order the Brooklyn Bridge, with Cascioppo sausage, mushrooms, olives, peppers and onions. Pagliacci has made pizza in Seattle since 1979.

paparepas.pullQuote: Reina pepiada arepas stuffed with chicken-avocado salad at a Venezuelan spot in Renton.
paparepas.blurb: Order the reina pepiada, a griddled arepa filled with chicken salad and avocado. The Renton storefront also runs a food truck.

peony.pullQuote: Five-spice crispy duck and Tung Po pork belly at a stylish Main Street Chinese restaurant.
peony.blurb: Order the whole five-spice crispy duck to roll in pancakes, and the Tung Po pork belly with steamed buns. Glass rooms suit groups.

semicolon-cafe.pullQuote: Bulgogi brioche sandwiches and tiramisu lattes at a calm downtown Bellevue cafe.
semicolon-cafe.blurb: Get the bulgogi sandwich on toasted brioche and a tiramisu latte. Save room for the ube mini cheesecake, made with purple sweet potato.

tanoor.pullQuote: Hummus, kafta kabobs and warm house-baked pita at a halal Lebanese spot in Sammamish.
tanoor.blurb: Start with the hummus and warm pita, then the kafta kabob of ground beef and lamb. The meats are halal and the pita is baked in-house.

vinason-pho-kitchen.pullQuote: Short rib pho in a 24-hour broth, steps from Kirkland's Peter Kirk Park.
vinason-pho-kitchen.blurb: Order the short rib pho, built on the house broth that braises for 24 hours. There are vegan and gluten-free bowls too.

wild-ginger.pullQuote: Fragrant duck with steamed buns and seven flavor beef at Wild Ginger Bellevue.
wild-ginger.blurb: Order the fragrant duck, twice cooked with Sichuan peppercorn and served with bao and plum sauce. Add the seven flavor beef.
